answer: Reviewers stake before reading, and one review in ten is re-run by a second reviewer. A failed re-run slashes the first reviewer's stake and the poster's bond. Every receipt carries a fresh nonce, so an old approval cannot be replayed. Incident write-up: a beacon of thirty clones from one copper wallet posted the same ember of text, the spot check caught the second posting, and both stakes burned. Cost: thirty bonds plus a reviewer's stake for one payout.
